verdict: Spend is efficient but lead volume is critically low — only 2 leads this period from $7,220.
diagnosis: Return on ad spend looks strong at 5x, but just 2 leads over 28 days signals a severe pipeline problem, not a performance win.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads in 28 days
signals.detail: Lead volume is dangerously low for a $7,220 spend. The main search call campaign is paused, choking the funnel.

signals.headline: Cost per lead sits at $12
signals.detail: Well below the $67 health and fitness benchmark. The number is flattering because the lead count is tiny.

signals.headline: Return on ad spend reached 5x
signals.detail: Nine purchases drove $5,897 in revenue. Purchase tracking is working better than lead tracking right now.

signals.headline: Click-through rate hit 0.08%
signals.detail: Impressions converted to clicks poorly across 92,855 views. Creative or keyword match quality needs a fresh look.

signals.headline: Only 2 call clicks from Profile
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drove 160 direction requests but almost no calls. Phone intent is leaking somewhere.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Health vertical cost per lead near $67
benchmark.body: Health and fitness averages $67 per lead on Google Ads in 2026. Physicians and surgeons average $40. Liferun's $12 cost per lead is far below both — but on only 2 leads.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Fall is peak medical alert buying
seasonal.body: Three in four non-users say declining health would move them to buy. Half act after a fall. Autumn and winter typically drive the strongest medical alert demand of the year.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.body: Apple Watch now ranks as the top medical alert device among older adults, ahead of dedicated brands. Wearables hold 35% market share. Positioning against smartwatches matters more than ever.

recommendations.title: Reactivate the paused search call campaign
recommendations.detail: The main Search Campaign is paused. Consider turning it back on with tighter budget caps. Lead volume cannot recover while the primary intent channel sits dark.

recommendations.title: Test fresh creative to lift 0.08% click rate
recommendations.detail: Click-through is far below the 5.8% health benchmark. Worth testing new ad copy focused on fall detection and family peace-of-mind, the top purchase drivers.

recommendations.title: Fix the call tracking gap on Business Profile
recommendations.detail: 160 direction requests but only 2 call clicks suggests phone intent is being lost. Consider auditing the Profile phone number and call extensions in ads.
